# PyRel application corpus

Five exact shipped models, 61 obligations and 137 addressed control entries.
Control entries may reuse identical input bytes; counts are scenario counts.
`matrix.json` supplies narrated stories, source models, targets, distinct-value
uniqueness siblings and the linked joint omission/source-disagreement controls.

`answers.json` separates original public GND observations from frozen native
expectations. Native expectations include every obligation disposition, guarded
witness, derived missing/extra tuple and overall acceptance result. Complete
BookRec expectations use computed eligibility. The two GND completeness source
disagreements are individually listed under approved plan amendment A1; both
populations must still be rejected. No further disagreement may be excluded
without another explicit approval.

`approval.json` pins exact matrix/answer hashes and the approved disagreement
inventory. Corpus tests enforce those hashes, complete-model source expectations,
control links and the full GND observation/witness key. The native driver refuses
changed answer bytes before execution and checks the whole acceptance report.
Legacy baseline audit completion remains separate from policy acceptance.
Unknown/vacuous/refusal format controls belong to PA1's separately authored lane;
these fully covered domain controls do not claim to cover those branches.
